ESP.ORIGINAL: Another artwork to complete!
ESP.TRADUIT: 又一件作品要完成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6Child1__000008AC_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaNtC_000008AC_1.fuz EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaNtC_000008AC_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6Child1__000008AC_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will enjoy spilling your blood!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会很享受让你血流成河的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaNtC_00000900_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll cower in the shadows!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只配缩在阴影里发抖！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaNtC_00000901_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa2_aaJenassa2DA014_00000901_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know fear, weakling!
ESP.TRADUIT: 尝尝恐惧的滋味吧，废物！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaNtC_00000902_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another life to extinguish!
ESP.TRADUIT: 又一条命，该熄灭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaNtC_00000904_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not my proudest work yet. But it'll do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算不上我最得意的作品。不过也凑合了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassa6Child1__000008B0_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\MaleChild\aaJenassa6Child1__000008B0_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaCtN_000008B0_1.fuz EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassa6Child1__000008B0_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaCtN_000008B0_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\MaleChild\aaJenassa6Child1__000008B0_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Embrace silence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拥抱沉默吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaCtN_00000903_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa2_aaJenassa2DA014_00000903_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, you feel the cold grip of death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你该感受到死亡冰冷的拥抱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaCtN_00000905_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000905_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从哪里来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Morrowind... that's where I'm from. A far cry from the frozen land of Skyrim, with the Red Mountain's heat looming always.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晨风……那是我的故乡。与这冰封的天际截然不同——红山的热浪永远在头顶逼近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaHello_000008B3_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_000008B3_1.fuz EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_000008B3_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaHello_000008B3_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Death encroaches the land like it's the norm, the grandeur of the ashen land is as remarkable as the lies and envy of one's neighbor-
ESP.TRADUIT: 死亡蚕食着那片土地，仿佛天经地义；灰烬之地的壮阔，与邻人的谎言与嫉妒同样触目惊心——
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_000008B3_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was home, for better or worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是我的家，无论好坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_000008B3_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the girl who made you stay in Windhelm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个让你留在风舵城的女孩呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For a time, she was the only light in that oppressive, hateful city. We had something special, something real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有那么一段时间，她是那座压抑又充满仇恨的城市里唯一的光。我们有过一些特别的、真实的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000093F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000093F_1.fuz EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000093F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000093F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the local Nords, they couldn't stand to see one of their own fraternizing with a Dunmer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可当地的诺德人，他们看不得自己人跟一个丹莫厮混。他们……他们把她从我身边夺走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000093F_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: They... they took her from me. Murdered her in cold blood, right in the streets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们……他们把她从我身边夺走了。就在大街上，活活杀了她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000093F_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Over three decades had passed, and I hadn't forgotten her even for one night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三十多年过去了，我没有一个夜晚忘记过她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Sad
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000093F_4.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did the East Empire Company have to do with this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 东帝国公司和这件事有什么关系？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were recruiting able hands to secure their business. At the time, the Empire's ships were occupied by the battles at the Abecean Sea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在招募能干的人手来保障生意。那时帝国的舰船正忙于阿贝希恩海的战事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000948_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000948_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without the Imperials to purge them, pirates grew rampant in the far north, raiding and sinking the East Empire Company's vessels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有帝国舰队清剿，海盗在极北之地越发猖獗，不断袭击和击沉东帝国公司的船只。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000948_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: They needed a veteran fighter who's familiar with the underworlds of both Skyrim and Morrowind, and that's where they saw the value in my service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们需要一个熟悉天际和晨风两地地下世界的老兵——这就是他们看中我的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000948_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: So they paid off my fine and purchased my freedom. Although to be more precise, I had merely exchanged the executioner's axe for a golden shackle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 于是他们替我缴清了罚金，买来了我的自由。不过说得准确些——我只是把刽子手的斧头换成了一副金色的镣铐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000948_4.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: An improvement, nonetheless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，总归是强了些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000948_5.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you've already fulfilled your end of the bargain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你已经履行完你那边的协议了吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As if it's ever so easy to shake off those goldmongers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好像摆脱那些金主是那么容易的事似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000094E_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000094E_1.fuz EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000094E_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000094E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: My service is still required from time to time. Usually when they need someone to get their hands dirty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们时不时还需要我的服务。通常是需要有人替他们干脏活的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000094E_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do get paid, of course, but it's little more than pocket money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，他们确实付钱，但那点钱跟零花钱没什么两样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000094E_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: "To offset the fine they've helped me pay," they say. Hmph.
ESP.TRADUIT: "用来抵消他们帮我付的罚金。"他们这么说。哼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000094E_4.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that interfere with your mercenary work with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会影响你跟着我做的雇佣工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am well-versed in the art of multi-tasking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对多线操作这门艺术颇有心得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000954_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000954_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000954_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000954_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: In truth, some of the bandit camps you come across just might number among my targets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，你碰到的那些强盗营地当中，有几个可能就是我的目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000954_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: A goldmonger has no lack of enemies, after all. A bandit here, a Forsworn there... A mercenary's work is never done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毕竟，一个金主从来不缺敌人。这里一个强盗，那里一个弃誓者……雇佣兵的活是干不完的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000954_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think I made the wrong choice, helping the Stormcloaks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我帮风暴斗篷是选错了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's quite obvious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得这答案显而易见了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_000009FE_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3C_000009FE_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But whichever side you're loyal to, I am bound by my contract to fight by your side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但无论你效忠于哪一边，合同在身，我都会在你身边战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3C_000009FE_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't mean I have to like what my blade is being used for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这剑要替那些人沾血——我可没说心甘情愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3C_000009FE_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to ask you something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问你点事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like being a mercenary then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你喜欢当雇佣兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate the art of death, and I never resent the gold. The rest is only a means to an end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我欣赏死亡的艺术，也从不嫌弃金币。其余的一切只是达到目的的手段罢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor5M_00000C98_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if there comes a day where I need not worry about food and bed, I think I might still hunt the occasional bandits, just to scratch that itch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就算有朝一日我不必为吃住发愁，我想我偶尔还是会去猎杀几个强盗——就为了解解痒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor5M_00000C98_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Motherhood is... strange. I've only known these tiny souls for a fragment of my years, yet I would lay down my life to protect our children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为人母……很奇怪。我只认识这些小小的灵魂短短数年，但我愿为了保护我们的孩子献出生命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000081D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaDB0_0000081D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Motherhood is... strange. I've only known this tiny soul for a fragment of my years, yet I would lay down my life to protect our child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为人母……很奇怪。我只认识这个小小的灵魂短短数年，但我愿为了保护我们的孩子献出生命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000081E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Having now a child of my own... I think I can understand how my mother felt, when she died to save me from the An-Xileel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在有了自己的孩子……我想我能理解母亲当年的感受了，那时她为了保护我免受安西尔族伤害而牺牲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000081F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Having now children of my own... I think I can understand how my mother felt, when she died to save me from the An-Xileel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在有了自己的孩子……我想我能理解母亲当年的感受了，那时她为了保护我免受安-西里尔伤害而牺牲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_00000820_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaDB1_00000820_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's late, love... Talk in the morning?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不早了，亲爱的……明早再聊？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_00000827_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I prayed to Azura for your return, and the Twilight Goddess delivered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我向阿祖拉祈祷你的归来，而黄昏女神回应了我的祈愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000080D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_0000080D_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_0000080D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000080D_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_0000080D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000080D_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000080D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_0000080D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know how you manage out there without me. The fights, you can handle... but the loneliness? That's what's unbearable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道没有我你是怎么在外应付的。战斗你能应付……但孤独呢？那才是难以忍受的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_00000808_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long are you planning to stay home this time? Whatever it is... make it longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次你打算在家待多久？不管多久……再长点吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_0000080E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've prepared some dishes per Dunmeri traditions. I hope you find them... agreeable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备了一些符合暗精灵传统的菜肴。希望你觉得……合胃口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_00000805_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_00000805_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_00000805_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_00000805_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_00000805_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_00000805_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa6_aaJenassa6Marri_00000805_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa_aaJenassaBackgro_00000805_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The kids seem to loathe the food I made, except the pies and the cakes. One day, I'll teach them to appreciate genuine Morrowind cuisine yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们似乎很讨厌我做的食物，除了派和蛋糕。总有一天，我会教会他们欣赏真正的晨风美食。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000800 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Shop1_0000090A_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like running a store, instead of being a sellsword?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢开店胜过当雇佣兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if I could, of course I prefer making art myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果可以的话，我当然更愿意亲手创造艺术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A69 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Shop2_0000090C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But since you need me to stay at home, helping others make art will have to suffice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但既然你需要我留在家里，帮别人创造艺术也只好将就了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A69 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Shop2_0000090C_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们聊点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A death cult rules this tomb. We should silence them forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死灵教派统治着这座墓穴。我们应该让他们永远安静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa2_aaJenassa2DA083_00000920_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000920_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: These necromancers toy with Death... They'll soon meet that which they think they master.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些死灵法师在玩弄死亡……他们很快就会与自认为掌控的东西面对面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000921_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder what drove that necromancer down this path. The Redguards hate the undead even more so than my kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想是什么驱使那个死灵法师走上这条路。红卫人比我们丹莫更憎恨亡灵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa2_aaJenassa2DA083_00000922_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000922_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can understand the Redguard necromancer. She'd bring down those who watched condescendingly as her beloved died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能理解那个红卫死灵法师。她要毁掉那些居高临下看着她爱人死去的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000091F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The necromancer's vengeance might be righteous, but her means had led to nothing but death... Let's leave this tomb behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死灵法师的复仇或许是正义的，但她的手段带来的只有死亡……我们离开这座墓穴吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000923_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems the Redoran Guards are crumbling to the Ash Spawn attacks. Raven Rock won't be the first city to be buried in ash, nor will it be the last.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来瑞多然卫兵在灰烬怪的攻击下节节败退。鸦石镇不会是第一个被灰烬掩埋的城市，也不会是最后一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000093F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000093F_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_0000093F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000093F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: These "Ash Spawn" are unlike anything I've seen back on the mainland. I suspect dark arts are involved in their creation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些"灰烬怪"跟我在大陆上见过的任何东西都不一样。我怀疑它们的诞生涉及黑暗法术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000093D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen the Imperials use criminals and Daedra, even undead when they're desperate - but an army of ashen monsters just might be the first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过帝国在绝望时使用罪犯、迪德拉，甚至亡灵——但一支灰烬怪物组成的大军，还真算是头一回。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000940_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000940_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000940_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000940_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder what preserved the Imperial General's body. For how long he had died, he didn't look rotten at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想是什么保存了那位帝国将军的尸体。死了那么久，他看起来竟然完全没有腐烂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000941_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Considering we just saved Raven Rock from certain destruction, the Captain should've been more generous. They make do with what they can, I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到我们刚刚拯救了鸦石镇，让它免于毁灭，那个队长本该更慷慨一些的。不过……我想他们也只能给出这么多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000942_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorBa_00000942_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done well killing that bandit back there. No one will mourn for thugs like her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得漂亮，杀了那个强盗。没会人会为那种暴徒哀悼的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000094F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: This crypt gives me a strange unease. The bandits aren't the only things that dwell here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座墓穴让我感到一种异样的不安。住在这里的可不只有那些强盗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would've cut down that bandit back there if it were up to me. Fools like her are just a waste of clean air.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我说，刚才那个强盗我早就砍了。她那种蠢货，连喘气都是在浪费干净的空气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see doubt and mutiny beset these bandits. We'll be wise to use that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些强盗里头猜忌和叛意丛生。我们最好利用这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000951_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shed no tears for those bandits, but ordeals like the Pale Lady are precisely why I loathe dealing with the dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会为那些强盗掉一滴泪，但像苍白夫人这种劫难——正是我厌恶跟死人打交道的理由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Altmer looks as if he'll cough his lungs out any moment. Will he even be alive to pay you when we get back?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个傲特莫看起来随时都会把肺咳出来。等我们回去的时候，他还能活着付你钱吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see the White Phial is nothing but a few fragments. Well, that's not our problem - let's get back to the Altmer for our payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来白瓶只剩下几块碎片了。好吧，那不是我们的问题——回去找那个傲特莫拿报酬吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000955_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: This Altmer is why I never take jobs from bedridden wretches. The dead pay no debts, and they know that all too well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个傲特莫就是为什么我从不接卧病在床的可怜虫的活。死人付不了债——他们自己最清楚这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000956_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if the White Phial can truly be repaired. Either way, I'll settle for the Phial or a fat purse of gold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想白瓶是否真的能修复。不管怎样，拿到白瓶或者一大袋金币，我都能接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000958_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, the White Phial is restored after all. Had the young alchemist failed to do so, I suppose this shop would need a new name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来白瓶终究还是修复了。如果那个年轻的炼金术士失败了——我想这家店得换个名字了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000959_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Having seen how the Rieklings stained this mead hall, I'll never trust anything brewed here - Nord reclamation or not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见识了那些瑞克灵怎么糟蹋这个蜜酒厅之后，——不管诺德人收不收复，这地方酿的东西我绝不会碰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000095A_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: That woman actually believed she stood a chance. What a fool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个女人居然以为自己有机会。真是个蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000095C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: People will say anything to excuse their failings. No matter - their payment is what counts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们为了给自己的失败开脱，什么话都说得出来。无所谓——他们付的钱才是要紧的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000095D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorMa_0000095D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard of the Red Eagle when I fought the Forsworn. They would scream his name in battle, as if it'd give them some divine protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟弃誓者战斗时听说过红鹰。他们会在战场上尖叫他的名字，仿佛那能给他们带来某种神灵庇佑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000095E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard the Red Eagle fought fiercely against Nord aggression. All that zeal turned out to be for naught after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说红鹰曾激烈抵抗诺德人的侵略。到头来，那股狂热终究成了一场空。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000095F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmorMa_0000095F_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We Dunmer have the Nerevarine. I suppose the Reachmen can have their Red Eagle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们丹莫有尼瑞瓦因。弃誓者有个红鹰也正常。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000960_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: All that's left of the Red Eagle are his sword and his title. Not his bloodline, not even his name. I suppose that's the fate of most heroes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 红鹰留下的只有他的剑和他的名号。没有他的血脉，甚至没有他的真名。我想这就是大多数英雄的命运吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Red Eagle is gone, and you're free to kill Nords and Forsworn alike with his sword. I suppose that's not the legacy he hoped for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 红鹰已经消逝了，而你可以用他的剑随意杀戮诺德人和弃誓者。我猜，那应该不是他想要的传承。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000962_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: There used to be a few Skooma cartels in Morrowind. I suppose the ash storms made for good cover for their operations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晨风以前也有几个斯库玛贩子团伙。我猜那些灰烬风暴正好帮他们打了掩护。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never taken Skooma myself. The stuff is poison for the mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己从不碰斯库玛。那东西就是心智的毒药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Riften will be Riften, with or without the Skooma cartel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 裂谷城就那样，有没有斯库玛贩子都一样。

NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000965_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if it's the wolves, the Skooma, or just the cave itself - but it stinks worse than a mine full of sulfur.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道是那些狼、那些斯库玛、还是这洞本身——反正比硫磺矿还臭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: The cartel is gone, and a new one will soon swoop in and claim their place - Riften will always be Riften.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贩子没了，很快又有新的扑进来占了他们的窝——裂谷城永远是裂谷城。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've killed Hagravens before. Those witches always talk in honeyed lies before placing you on the altar. Let's stay guarded around this Illia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前杀过乌鸦鬼婆。那些巫婆嘴上说得好听，回头就把你送上祭坛。对这个伊雅，咱们还是留个心眼。

ESP.TRADUIT: 到了这一步，伊雅杀的女巫已经远远超过赢取你信任所需了。要么她说的句句属实——要么她就是我见过最会演戏的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see I misjudged Illia when I first saw her. She truly intended to do the right thing.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you feel it too? There's an ominous chill in these ruins, whispering of terrors from ages past.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也感觉到了吧？这遗迹里有股不祥的寒意，低语着来自远古的恐惧。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒想知道这个弗洛伦修斯有多大本事。阿凯的祭司？他打算怎么着——给吸血鬼驱魔？还是为他们的灵魂祈祷？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000A4F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Florentius... 'talk' to his god? Now I see why the people had that hesitant tone when they asked you to find him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗洛伦修斯……能跟他的神'说话'？现在我明白那些人请你去找他的时候，为什么语气那么犹豫了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000A50_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two elves who kidnapped a blacksmith? They're either from Raven Rock or the Thalmor - and I assure you, my people have no interest in Nord armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两个精灵绑架了一个铁匠？要么是乌鸦岩来的，要么是梭默——我跟你保证，我族人对诺德盔甲可没兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000A52_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought this isle would be the last place to interest a Thalmor. Surely, there are greener pastures to conquer or plunder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为这座岛是梭默最不可能感兴趣的地方。肯定有更好的地方值得他们征服或掠夺吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder what magic this 'Stalhrim' contains, so powerful that it made the Thalmor come all this way from Alinor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想这'魔冰'里到底有什么魔力，能让梭默从艾琳诺千里迢迢赶来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000A55_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never expected that we'd do business with the Thalmor, but whoever pays well, I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没想到有一天我们居然会和梭默做交易——不过，谁出价高就跟谁做，我想是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've started to imagine how a Thalmor would look in Stalhrim armor. A blue Altmer would look like quite the spectacle, don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我开始想象一个梭默穿上魔冰盔甲会是什么样子了。蓝皮肤的高精灵——那场面一定很壮观，你不觉得吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000A57_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not my first time escorting a historian through an old ruin, though my first was inconceivably more talkative... and annoying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我第一次护送历史学家逛遗迹了。不过上一个话多得吓人……而且烦人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Empire built fortresses like this to last. Considering its age, it still holds up well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帝国建造的堡垒就是这样经久耐用。以它的年代来看，它仍然保存得很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could get used to this place. The darkness gives me a warm comfort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能习惯这个地方。黑暗给我一种温暖的慰藉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000912_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the wars and the debts, the Jarls and the generals have gradually lost control of their forts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 由于战争和债务，领主们和将军们渐渐失去了对堡垒的控制。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imperial forts like this used to dot the landscapes of Morrowind. After the Red Year, they've mostly crumbled into dust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像这样的帝国堡垒曾经遍布晨风的大地。红年之后，它们大多已经化为尘土了。

NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000914_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I once wiped out a fortress in a single night. Poisoned wine does the trick every time - that, and my silent steps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经一夜之间灭掉了一座堡垒。毒酒每次都管用——再加上我无声的步伐。

NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Solitude is one of the few Skyrim cities that agree with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 独孤城是少数几个让我觉得合拍的天际城市之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_00000919_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Solitude values real art, yet it's never lacking in schemes and shadows. This just might be the perfect city for someone like me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 独孤城珍视真正的艺术，但这里的阴谋和暗影也从来不缺。这或许正是适合我这样的人的城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may enjoy Nord mead, but Solitude's fine wine is unlike any other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我或许喜欢喝诺德蜜酒，但独孤城的精品葡萄酒别具一格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000091B_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Adara and I used to play with the instruments at the day's end. So many fond memories we had with the flutes...
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿达拉和我以前常在一天结束时演奏乐器。我们用那些笛子留下了那么多美好的回忆……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe we can play with the flute later, like I used to with Adara.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我们待会可以吹吹笛子，就像我以前和阿达拉那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000091D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: One can make such great art with a flute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一支笛子也能创造出如此伟大的艺术。

NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if the dragons feel fear. That must be the only thing they know when you devour their souls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想龙会不会感到恐惧。当你吞噬它们的灵魂时，那一定就是它们唯一能感受到的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been struck by the soul trap spell a few times. When you absorb the dragons' souls, I can only imagine they feel the agony tenfold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被摄魂陷阱击中过几次。当你吸收龙魂的时候，我只能想象它们承受的痛苦是你的十倍。

NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, the dragon god made you to kill his children and eat their souls? I've seen worse parents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，龙神造出你就是为了杀死他的孩子，吃掉他们的灵魂？我见过更差劲的父母。

NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you think the dragons are irritating, then you don't know the cliff racers. Those nasty critters never have the decency to stay grounded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你觉得龙很烦人，那是你没见识过峭壁行者。那些讨厌的东西从来不懂得待在地上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The dragons breathe magic as effortlessly as we spit. It would be wise to take precautions against their ice or fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 龙吐息魔法就像我们吐口水一样轻松。最好做好防范，抵御它们的冰霜或火焰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose this place can't get any filthier... Bathing time can't come soon enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这个地方不会再更脏了……真想赶紧洗个澡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The longer we stay here, the more we smell like this place's denizens. I suggest we find the nearest pond soon as we leave this accursed place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在这里待得越久，身上的味道就越像这里的居民。我建议一离开这个该死的地方就去找最近的水塘。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A thorough bath always does us adventuring type wonders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好洗个澡，对我们这些冒险者来说总是有奇效。

Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Idle_0000094B_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't we have a long, warm bath - just you and me, undisturbed by anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们何不洗个长长的热水澡——就你和我，不受任何打扰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have a long road ahead. A quick bath in a nearby pond ought to refresh our spirits... Not to mention it'll get rid of the odor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前路漫漫。在附近的水塘里快速洗个澡，应该能让我们的精神振作起来……更别说还能去掉身上的臭味。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But no matter. Soon as our contract is over, the Stormcloaks will see their patrols disappear without a trace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过无所谓了。等合同一结束，风暴斗篷就会发现他们的巡逻队消失得无影无踪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tolerate the Stormcloaks because of you, my love - but had it not been for you, I'd see their patrols slaughtered in the dark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我容忍风暴斗篷是因为你，我的爱人——但若不是因为你，我早就看着他们的巡逻队在暗处被屠戮殆尽了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Raven Rock's assassination plot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对鸦石镇的刺杀阴谋怎么看？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Assassination, family feuds, backstabbing - these are all parts of a Dunmer noble's daily life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刺杀、家族世仇、背后捅刀——这都是丹莫贵族日常生活的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know which side is more right in this situation - the Redoran or the Ulen. But knowing Morrowind, the answer is most certainly neither.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道在这种情况下哪一方更正确——是瑞多然还是乌伦。但以我对晨风的了解，答案肯定两方都不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: But no matter. Point your blade at the Ulen, and I'll wipe them out as you desire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过无所谓。只要你把剑指向乌伦，我就按你的意愿把他们清除干净。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is neither side right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么两边都不对？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Great Houses feud over lands, gold and ancestral claims. The conflict between the Redoran and the Ulen was no different, whatever they may say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大家族之间的世仇无非是为了土地、金币和祖先宣称权。瑞多然和乌伦之间的冲突也不例外，不管他们怎么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR021_00000928_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000928_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, the Redoran can make all their claims about their righteous purge of House Hlaalu. The dead cannot talk back after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，瑞多然可以大谈他们如何正义地清算了哈拉鲁家族。毕竟死人不会反驳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR021_00000928_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems you're no stranger to Great House politics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你对大家族的政治并不陌生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In my childhood, I'd occasionally play the inconspicuous urchin for Great House schemers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小时候，我偶尔会为那些大家族阴谋家扮演不起眼的小乞丐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: While I poured their Matze, those gluttonous nobles would announce their grand plot to their allies, only for me to trade it for a warm meal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我在倒玛兹的时候，那些饕餮贵族会向盟友宣布他们的宏伟计划——而我则拿这些情报换一顿热饭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092A_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's almost pitiful how no one ever suspected a drink pourer, just because she seemed all harmless and small.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从来没有人怀疑过一个倒酒的，就因为她看起来人畜无害、身材矮小——这几乎让人觉得可怜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092A_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's dishonorable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那可不光彩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In contrast to those who literally plotted to murder my employers for power?
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟那些为了权力而密谋谋杀我雇主的人比起来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092C_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_0000092C_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_0000092C_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honor is only a fancy garment afforded by those who live in peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 荣誉不过是只有生活在和平中的人才穿得起的一件华丽外衣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092C_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: A meal in exchange of political advantage? Sounds like a bargain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一顿饭换一个政治优势？听起来挺划算的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They needed their advantage, and I needed my belly to stop drumming. All things considered, we both got what we wanted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们需要他们的优势，而我要让自己的肚子不再咕咕叫。总的来说，我们都得到了想要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092E_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_0000092E_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_0000092E_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But of course, my loyalty is much more expensive than porridge and meat nowadays.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，如今我的忠诚，可比一碗粥和肉贵得多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_0000092E_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you've adapted to the shadows since your childhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你从小就已经适应了暗影。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess this life chose me as much as I chose it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，与其说我选择了这种生活，不如说它选择了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_00000930_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000930_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000930_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR022_00000930_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, these Dunmeri intrigues are too messy for my liking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，这些暗精灵的阴谋太混乱了，我不喜欢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I won't blame you for it... Our society is as complex as a maze to most, with each exit leading only to another labyrinth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也不会因此责怪你……我们的社会对大多数人来说就像一座迷宫，每个出口通向的只是另一座迷宫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR023_00000932_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000932_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000932_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR023_00000932_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you did resolve the Silver-Blood situation in Markarth, did you not? I say this is child's play compared to that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，你不是解决了马卡斯城银血家族的事吗？跟那件事比起来，这不过是小儿科。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR023_00000933_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000933_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000933_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR023_00000933_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any event, you accepted a contract from the Councilor. It's only fair that you complete his task, or let him know your wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，你接受了议员的合同。完成他的任务，或者让他知道你的意愿——这才公平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR023_00000935_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000935_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIdle_aaIdle_00000935_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR023_00000935_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's find out those Ulen and finish them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找到那些乌伦家族的家伙，干掉他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR024_00000937_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the Ulen are a threat to Raven Rock's peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但乌伦家族对鸦石镇的和平构成了威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A threat to the Redoran's peace. Had it been the Ulen who ruled Raven Rock, the Redoran would've attempted the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是对瑞多然家族的和平的威胁。如果是乌伦家族统治鸦石镇，瑞多然也会做同样的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR021_00000939_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Different names, same plots. Such is the long saga of my people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不同的名号，同样的阴谋。这就是我族人漫长的编年史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR021_00000939_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The victor wrote the history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 历史是胜利者书写的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that's the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实正是如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR021_0000093B_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're employed by the East Empire Company, how can you still work for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你既然受雇于东帝国公司，怎么还能为我工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To answer it simply, they don't require my service every moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 简单说——他们不是时时刻刻都需要我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_0000096A_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm free to pursue other work while they have no need for me. The more contracts I complete, the sooner I can repay this debt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们用不着我的时候，我可以自由接别的活。我完成的合同越多，就能越早还清这笔债。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_0000096A_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But where they need my service, I'll be obligated to abandon all other work to serve their interests. Such are the terms of their 'offer'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但只要他们需要我，我就有义务放下所有其他工作，为他们办事。这就是他们那个'提议'的条款。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_0000096A_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds only fair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来还算公平。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair to the Company, as always.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对公司公平罢了——一向如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_0000096C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do they pay you when they don't need you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不用你的时候，也付你钱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you wouldn't pay for a mead you didn't drink, then why would they pay for a service they didn't use?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会为没喝的蜜酒付钱——那他们为什么要为没用的服务付钱？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_0000096E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds harsh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来真够苛刻的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When an Imperial sets the terms, they've already calculated all their gains and losses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帝国人定条件的时候，早就把自己的得失都算得一清二楚了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_00000970_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, what will happen to us if they summon you now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，要是他们现在把你召回去，我们怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'll have no choice but to return to their service until their need for me expires. Unless you wish to come along, that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就只能回去，直到他们不再需要我为止。当然——除非你愿意一起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_00000972_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: If not... I suppose the least I could do is to give you a refund.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不来的话……我想我至少还能把钱退给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Worki_00000972_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you giving me that look, Jenassa?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么那样看着我，简拉萨？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000973 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis2__00000976_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2G_00000976_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000973 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis2__00000978_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I can tell something's on your mind. You looked just like Faida when she lost my brother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我看得出来你有心事。你刚才的表情，就像菲达失去我哥哥时那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000973 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis2__0000097A_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I... You look like someone from my past, is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我……你看起来像我过去认识的一个人，就这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000973 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis2__0000097C_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2M_0000097C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, I'd say I could be that person, but I'm certain I'd remember you. After all, you leave quite the impression on everyone you meet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，我倒想说我可能就是那个人——但我肯定我会记得你。毕竟，你给每个见过你的人都留下了深刻的印象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000973 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis2__0000097E_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2M_0000097E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you can't possibly be her... She died thirty years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不可能是她……她三十年前就死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000973 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis2__00000980_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2M_00000980_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jenassa, you mentioned I looked like someone from your past... who died thirty years ago? Who was that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 简拉萨，你说我看起来像你过去认识的一个人……三十年前就死了？那是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis3__00000985_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was my first love in Skyrim. The one who taught me that warmth exists even in the frozen north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是我在天际的第一个爱人。是她教会我——即使在冰封的北方，也有温暖存在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis3__00000987_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. I didn't realize she was your... I mean, my condolences.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。我不知道她是你……我是说，请节哀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis3__00000989_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis3__0000098B_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2H_0000098B_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was a bard - the most gifted of her class. When we were together, she'd always perform the world's most beautiful art for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是个诗人——那是她那一行里最有天分的人。我们在一起的时候，她总是为我演奏这世上最美的艺术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis3__0000098D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2H_0000098D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm no bard - the far opposite of one, if that's what you're asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不是什么诗人——恰恰相反，如果你问的是这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis3__0000098F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2H_0000098F_1.fuz NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2H_0000098F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis3__0000098F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fine. I have found an artist just as great as she was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。我已经找到了一个和她一样了不起的艺术家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis3__00000991_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2H_00000991_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I'm not asking you to be one. We are each who we are... to presume otherwise brings nothing but sorrow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也没有要求你成为那样的人。我们各自做自己就好……以为别人应该是什么样子，只会带来痛苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000982 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis3__00000992_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2H_00000992_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, Jenassa - what's with your obsession over 'art'?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，简拉萨——你为什么对'艺术'这么执着？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000993 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis1__00000996_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2M_00000996_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The world would be a colorless place without it, no?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有艺术，这世界就失去色彩了，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000993 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis1__00000998_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2M_00000998_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. But from the sound of it, the only color of your art is bloody red!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。但听你这么说，你的艺术唯一的颜色——就是血红色吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000993 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we each have our preferences. Some play their lutes... while I stick to my sword.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们各有各的喜好。有人弹鲁特琴……而我坚守我的剑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000993 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis1__0000099C_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2M_0000099C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what is your art, Jordis - if you have one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你的艺术是什么，乔蒂丝——如果你有的话？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000993 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis1__0000099E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, not singing or dancing, that's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，反正不是唱歌也不是跳舞，这个可以肯定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000993 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis1__000009A0_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look happy, Jenassa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来很幸福，简拉萨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis4__000009A5_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor2M_000009A5_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: All because of your Thane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全都是因为你的武卫大人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis4__000009A7_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't look like the type to settle down... But it suits you. Now it's as if I'm seeing my brother and Faida again, ever the joyful couple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来不像那种会安定下来的人……但这很适合你。现在我仿佛又看到了我哥哥和菲达，永远那么幸福的一对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009A9_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis4__000009A9_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seeing people from your past, Jordis?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到了过去认识的人，乔蒂丝？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaJordis4__000009AB_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009AB_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. You got me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。被你看穿了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jordis the Sword-Maiden [000A2C8F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleYoungEager\aaJenassaJordis4__000009AD_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me something about your mother, Illia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你母亲的事吧，伊雅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia1__000009B6_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? I didn't realize you cared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？我不知道你居然还关心这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia1__000009B8_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: My own mother died to save me from the An-Xileel... Were I in your place, I could never bring myself to hurt her... Let alone kill her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己的母亲为了从安-希雷尔手下救我而死的……如果我是你，我绝对下不了手伤害她……更别说杀了她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia1__000009BA_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were lucky to have your mother then, Jenassa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你那时候很幸运，还能有你的母亲，简拉萨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia1__000009BC_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe at one point, mine would've made the same sacrifice. But after years of corruption, I doubt she still loved anything besides power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许曾经，我的母亲也愿意做出同样的牺牲。但经过这么多年的堕落，我怀疑她除了权力，已经不再爱任何东西了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia1__000009BE_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was that why you struck her down?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以那就是你打倒她的原因？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia1__000009C0_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. At that point, all I knew was that I must stop the coven and their human sacrifice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。那一刻，我只知道我必须阻止那个女巫团和他们的人祭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia1__000009C2_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I would've chosen differently had my mother shown a bit more warmth. But then, she wouldn't be that power-mad Hag we slew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我母亲曾表现出哪怕一丝温情，也许我会做出不同的选择。但那样的话——她就不会是那个我们杀死的、被权力冲昏了头的鬼婆了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009B3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia1__000009C4_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me something about Morrowind, Jenassa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说晨风的事吧，简拉萨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to be more specific with your question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得问得再具体一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, specific... how?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，具体……怎么个具体法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:

ESP.ORIGINAL: Morrowind is a big place. Dozens of cities, hundreds of species, with five noble houses each trying to kill the others every day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晨风是个很大的地方。几十座城市，数百个物种，五个贵族家族天天都在互相残杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009C6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia2__000009CF_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009CF_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't know what to ask, because I knew nothing at all about the world outside the Tower. But you just gave me something to work with... Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道该问什么，因为塔外面的世界我什么都不知道。但你刚才给了我一些能了解的东西……谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009C6 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
