ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, why don't you just go read a book? Surely, the witches taught you to read?
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，你干嘛不自己去读本书呢？那些女巫总该教过你认字吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009C6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia2__000009D3_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009D3_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Illia - I noticed your disgust when I prayed to the Three earlier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊雅——我注意到了，刚才我向三神祈祷时，你露出了厌恶的表情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia3__000009D7_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were praying to the Daedra.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在向迪德拉祈祷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia3__000009D9_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who I worship is my business. Why don't you mind your sorceries, witch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我信仰谁是我的事。你管好你的巫术就行了，女巫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia3__000009DB_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009DB_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was doing exactly that - until you had to bring it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正是在这么做——直到你非要把这事挑明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009DD_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia3__000009DD_1.fuz NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) NPC : [0004B22E] (ID) Quest : 060009D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleEvenToned\aaJenassaIllia3__000009DD_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009DD_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Then we understand each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。那我们互相理解了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Illia [00048C2F] (file) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060009D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaIllia3__000009DF_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009DF_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Wolfskull Cave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看狼头骨洞穴？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think the Steward is a fool to dismiss that villager's warning - but at least, he has half the wisdom to hire professionals to investigate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得总管是个蠢货，根本没把那个村民的警告当回事——但至少他还有一半脑子，知道雇专业人士来调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS060_000009E2_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just hope he pays well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只希望他出手够大方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS060_000009E2_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not about the money for me. It's about saving people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说不是钱的问题。是要救人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A thousand people would fight for a thousand reasons. In the end, the only thing that matters is the job gets done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一千个人会为一千种理由而战。到头来，唯一重要的——是活儿干完了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS061_000009E4_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_000009E4_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why wouldn't the Steward pay well?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总管怎么会不肯出够钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Solitude is the pearl of the north, so I don't doubt that its coffer has more than enough for two hired blades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 独孤城是北方的明珠，我一点也不怀疑它的金库够付两个佣兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS062_000009E6_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the Steward sees Wolfskull Cave's rumors as a farce. That's why he didn't even care to send reinforcements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但总管把狼头骨洞穴的传闻当成一场闹剧。所以他连派援军都不上心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS062_000009E6_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: A small pouch for our time, that's the payment he expects to afford.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一小袋金币打发我们的时间——那就是他打算付的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS062_000009E6_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the war going on, Solitude really can't afford to investigate mere rumors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仗还在打呢，独孤城确实抽不出人去调查区区谣言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't that the most convenient excuse everyone uses these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这难道不是如今每个人都用的最顺手的借口吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS063_000009E8_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: A farm was raided by bandits? The soldiers are off at the war camp. The city's water needs to be sanitized? The gold is all in the war chest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 农场被强盗洗劫了？——士兵们都在前线营地呢。城里的水需要净化了？——金币全在军需箱里呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS063_000009E8_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe the Jarls are more interested in painting the map than governing their people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许领主们更热衷于在地图上涂抹疆域，而不是好好治理他们的子民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS063_000009E8_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Steward should've done more to help his people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总管本该为他的子民做更多事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Nords are all about their honor, and nothing's more honorable than killing others on the battlefield.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺德人满嘴都是荣誉，而没有什么比在战场上杀敌更荣誉的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS064_000009EA_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's the honor in keeping some peasants happy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让几个农民过上好日子——荣誉又在哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS064_000009EA_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, the Steward's thoughts are of little consequence to us. We'll just keep doing what we always do best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，总管怎么想对我们来说无关紧要。我们只管继续做我们最擅长的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS063_000009EE_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Falk Firebeard doesn't seem like a warmonger to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: “火胡”佛可在我眼里不像个好战分子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yet those around him are all sounding the war drums. Even if the Steward wanted to care, the warmongers wouldn't have permitted him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可围着他的人全都在敲战鼓。就算总管想关心——好战分子也不会允许他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS064_000009F0_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough with your cynicism. I'll hear no more of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够了，你的愤世嫉俗我听够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe don't ask for my thoughts next time, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你下次就别问我的看法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS064_000009F2_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you care about the peasants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你在乎那些农民吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obviously no. I merely made an observation after spending decades on this land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然不在乎。我只不过在这片土地上待了几十年，随口说了一句观察罢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS064_000009F4_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're all short-sighted fools.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全都是目光短浅的蠢货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they see any further beyond the glory at hand, it would be a betrayal of their proud heritage, no?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是他们能看到眼前的荣耀之外的东西——那岂不是背叛了他们引以为傲的传统，你说是不是？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS064_000009F6_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Solitude's lighthouse?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看独孤城的灯塔那件事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean the Argonian pirate's 'proposition'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说那个亚龙人海盗的'提议'吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A02_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why you're even considering to entertain him. If I know pirates, they're never going to share their spoil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白你为什么还在考虑跟他周旋。以我对海盗的了解——他们绝不会把战利品分给别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A02_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides - should an East Empire Company vessel be wrecked after this, then the situation with my debtor will become most... peculiar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说——要是之后有东帝国公司的船在这里遇难——那我跟债主之间的事可就变得……微妙了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3C_00000A04_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A04_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides - should an East Empire Company vessel be wrecked after this, then we'll earn the ire of Cyrodiil's greatest power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说——要是之后有东帝国公司的船在这里遇难——那我们就会招来赛洛迪尔最强大的势力的怒火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3C_00000A05_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A05_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may no longer be chained to them, but their eyes are always present in Haafingar. Many more like me are still at their disposal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我或许已经不再被他们拴着了，但在哈芬加尔，他们的眼线无处不在。还有很多像我一样的人——仍然受他们支配。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3C_00000A05_2.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A05_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion may fight honorably... but the Company does not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团也许会光明正大地战斗……但公司不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3C_00000A05_3.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A05_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides - should an East Empire Company vessel be wrecked after this, then we'll earn the ire of Cyrodiil's greatest power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说——要是之后有东帝国公司的船在这里遇难——那我们就会招来赛洛迪尔最强大的势力的怒火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A27_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_00000A27_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_00000A27_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A27_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion may fight honorably... but the Company does not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团也许会光明正大地战斗……但公司不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A27_2.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_00000A27_2.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_00000A27_2.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS070_00000A27_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I'll ignore the Argonian pirate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放心吧，我不会理那个亚龙人海盗的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your wisdom is greater than you realized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的智慧比你自己以为的还要大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS071_00000A07_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested to see this through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想把这件事看到底。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That pirate is a fool. All he spouts is rot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个海盗就是个蠢货。从他那张嘴里吐不出象牙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well. Now that you mention it... What kind of criminal would recruit an accomplice on the street?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。既然你提到了……什么罪犯会在大街上招募同伙？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS073_00000A0C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only the foolish or the careless, I'd imagine - and neither make for good schemers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想只有傻子或者粗心鬼才干得出来——而这两样人都成不了好的阴谋家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS073_00000A0C_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are riches awaiting us in this job. We just have to go and grab it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这活儿里有财宝等着我们。去拿就是了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There will come a day your curiosity leads us to safe havens and good fortune, but I see that day is still far away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总有一天，你的好奇心会带我们去到安全的避风港和好运——但在我看来，那一天还早着呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A0F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Share_00000A0F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Morthal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看墨索尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, I appreciate silence and solitude - but in Morthal, even the silence grows suffocating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常来说，我喜欢安静和独处——但在墨索尔，连安静都压得人喘不过气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS140_00000A13_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: A house was burnt down and a family ruined, yet the suspect still walks freely under the sun, and the town goes about its business as usual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 房子烧了，家毁了——嫌疑人却还在光天化日之下自由走动，镇上的人也照常过他们的日子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS140_00000A13_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's as if that's the norm here. Still, indifferent... and dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好像这就是这里的常态似的。死寂，冷漠……没有一点生气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS140_00000A13_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I intend to unravel the mystery here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打算揭开这里的谜团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unravel the mystery, or upset the design of the forces that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 揭开谜团，还是搅乱当权者的布局？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS141_00000A15_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe we should get away while we can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许趁还来得及，我们该走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wise caution can often be confused with cowardice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明智的谨慎常常被人误认为是懦弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS142_00000A17_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: In my view, there's no point saving a place that doesn't care to be saved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 依我看，拯救一个不在乎自己有没有救的地方——毫无意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS142_00000A17_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go then. I can hardly wait to breathe freely again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那走吧。我快等不及想好好喘口气了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS142_00000A17_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The burnt family demands justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个被烧毁的家庭需要公道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see your point. It may not save a soul... but the dead will find some small comfort if we avenge them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白你的意思。也许救不了谁……但如果我们替他们报了仇，死者也能得到一丝安慰吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A19_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS143_00000A19_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what we expect to find in this town, or what yet awaits us in the marsh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我们指望在这镇上找到什么，也不知道沼泽里还有什么在等着我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A1B_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS141_00000A1B_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if Death is looming over Morthal, then I say we feed it what it desires - the blood of those responsible for the terror.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果死神正笼罩着墨索尔——那我说，就喂给它想要的：那些对这起恐怖事件负责的人的鲜血。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8MS141_00000A1B_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Raven Rock Mine's secrets?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看乌鸦岩矿井的秘密？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Knowing how the East Empire Company operates, it wouldn't surprise me that they've concealed secrets beneath the mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以我对东帝国公司行事风格的了解，他们在矿井下面藏了秘密——我一点也不意外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR030_00000A24_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It exists to generate wealth for the noble houses. Everything else is expendable for that goal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座矿井的存在就是为了给贵族家族创造财富。除此之外的一切，为了这个目标都可以牺牲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR030_00000A24_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: For them to shut down the mine, I see two explanations - one, they stood to gain much from what lied beneath, so they kept it sealed for themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们关闭矿井，我看有两个解释——第一，下面的东西能让他们大赚一笔，所以他们把它封起来留给自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR030_00000A24_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: And two, they stood to lose much more if they let the mine be. That means whatever they'd hidden beneath... is best left forgotten.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第二，如果让矿井继续开下去，他们失去的会多得多。也就是说，不管他们藏在下面的是什么……最好就此遗忘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR030_00000A24_4.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think they've hidden down there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他们下面藏了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt even the Vici themselves knew, let alone a mere sellsword they employed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑连维西家族自己都不清楚，更别说他们雇来的卖命佣兵了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR031_00000A26_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I honestly don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR031_00000A28_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I were to entertain a guess, it'd either be a Nordic ruin, full of undead longing for flesh - or a Dwemer ruin, with their steels of death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果非要我猜的话——要么是一座诺德遗迹，里面全是渴望血肉的亡灵——要么是一座锻莫遗迹，遍布他们那致命的钢铁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR031_00000A2A_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Company might not care much for things besides profit, but it still operated under the Emperor's grace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 公司除了利润之外或许不关心别的——但它终究是在皇帝的恩典下运作的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR031_00000A2A_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should an army of undead swarm the town, the Emperor - and by extension, the Company - would have much to answer for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果一支亡灵大军涌向城镇，皇帝——连带着公司——都难逃其咎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR031_00000A2A_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think we should leave the mine alone then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你是觉得我们不该管这个矿井？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe we should delve deeper and see what the Company has hidden.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为我们应该深入下去，看看公司到底藏了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR032_00000A2C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where there are risks, there are opportunities. Whatever secret lies below, it is worth protecting to the Company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪里有风险，哪里就有机会。不管下面藏着什么秘密——那东西值得公司如此守护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR032_00000A2C_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: That either means it can make us rich, or it can change the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那要么意味着它能让我们发财，要么意味着它能改变世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR032_00000A2C_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The East Empire Company's secrets await.
ESP.TRADUIT: 东帝国公司的秘密在等着我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR033_00000A2E_1.fuz NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3M_00000A2E_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8RR033_00000A2E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: If someone pays you to, would you ever betray your patron?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有人出钱，你会背叛你的雇主吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose this question arose from my profession.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这个问题是冲着我的职业来的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A3C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who put such thoughts in you? I suppose it's that sorry failure Lydia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁让你有这种想法的？我猜是那个可怜的废物莱迪亚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A3D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may work for gold, but I will never sully my art by betraying those who afforded it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我或许为金币而工作——但我绝不会用背叛来玷污我的艺术，背叛那些花钱让我施展艺术的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A3F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Learn to appreciate my art, unless you want this fear to come true... when our contract expires.
ESP.TRADUIT: 学着欣赏我的艺术吧——除非你想让这个担心成真……等我们的合同到期的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A41_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: After all the time we've spent together, I thought you had started to appreciate my art. I guess I was wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一起经历了这么多，我以为你已经学会欣赏我的艺术了。看来是我错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A42_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3B_00000A42_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, Jenassa. I didn't mean that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，简拉萨。我不是那个意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Let's put those thoughts behind us for good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。那就把这些想法彻底扔到脑后吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A44_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3B_00000A44_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't the Dunmer like treachery?
ESP.TRADUIT: 暗精灵不是最喜欢背信弃义吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Against enemies, not those whose coin feeds me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是对敌人——不是对那些用钱养活我的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A46_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3B_00000A46_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you stay silent for a while, until you've grown a mind of your own, at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不如先安静一会儿——至少等你自己长了脑子再开口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A46_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走着瞧吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess we will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来也只能这样了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A48_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3B_00000A48_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't bring Lydia into this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别把莱迪亚扯进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So it's your own thought, then. Very well... I see now how you truly look at me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，这是你自己的看法了。很好……我现在知道你真正是怎么看我的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8Betra_00000A4A_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3B_00000A4A_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not your first time escorting a historian?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是第一次护送历史学家了吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The first time I took on such a contract, it was in another Nord ruin. I reckon it was even bigger than this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我第一次接这种活，是在另一座诺德遗迹里。我估摸着比这座还要大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV010_00000A5C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Supposedly, that ruin was built above an ancient Falmer burial ground, which the Nords defiled and destroyed during their conquests.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说那座遗迹建在一处古老的雪精灵墓地上方——诺德人在征服途中把它玷污并摧毁了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV010_00000A5C_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: This historian believed the Falmer ghosts had possessed the Draugr there, and intended to prove it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个历史学家相信雪精灵的鬼魂附在了那里的尸鬼身上，打算以此证明自己的理论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV010_00000A5C_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was that historian an elf?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个历史学家是精灵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a full-blooded Nord. Dressed like one, drank like one, even breathed like one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纯血的诺德人。穿得像诺德人，喝得像诺德人，连喘气都像诺德人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV011_00000A5E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only thing that was different? He claimed his 28th great-grandmother was the last Falmeri princess, which made him the true heir to their legacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一不一样的地方？他声称他的第28代曾祖母是最后一位雪精灵公主——所以他才是雪精灵遗产的真正继承人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV011_00000A5E_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened in that ruin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那座遗迹里后来怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened was that he kept yapping about the ancient Falmer and their glory, how the Nords' revenge for Saarthal was too harsh, and so on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来啊——他一直在喋喋不休地讲古老的雪精灵和他们的辉煌，说什么诺德人对萨瑟尔的报复太过分了，诸如此类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A60_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: After a certain point, I simply stopped paying attention. He gave the ruin many more pieces of his mind, no doubt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到后来，我就干脆不听了。他肯定对那座遗迹发表了很多高论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A60_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you'd agree with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为你会同意他的说法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I'm an elf?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就因为我是精灵？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A62_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: We Dunmer hardly even care about our own brethren, until the circumstances drive us to band together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们暗精灵连自己的同胞都几乎不怎么放在心上——除非情况逼得我们必须团结。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A62_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I can say is that the Falmer got their fate, and history is already written.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只能说——雪精灵得到了他们应得的命运，而历史已经写就。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A62_3.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a fool. The Falmer are gone, only the monsters are left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个蠢货。雪精灵早就没了，只剩下那些怪物了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My thought exactly. But why should an artist argue with her patron?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是这么想的。不过——一个艺术家何必跟出钱的人争辩呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A64_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A64_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did the historian get what he was looking for in the Nord ruin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个历史学家在诺德遗迹里找到他想要的东西了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently no. There were plenty of Draugr... but besides a Wispmother and a few dozens of her spawn, we found no trace of the Falmer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然没有。里面尸鬼倒是不少……但除了一个雾母和她的几十个崽子，雪精灵的踪迹我们半点也没找到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A66_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A66_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was devastated, but no matter. All I cared was getting my hard-earned pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他整个人都垮了，不过无所谓。我只在乎拿到我辛苦挣来的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV012_00000A66_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think Tharstan is better than him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得萨斯顿比他强吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tharstan's talkative, sure... but at least he also tries to be helpful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 萨斯顿确实话多……但他至少还会帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV013_00000A68_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as historians go, he might make for the best patron of his kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就历史学家来说，他可能算是这类人里最好的雇主了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 060008F1 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassa8_aaJenassa8SV013_00000A68_2.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was once like you, young one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也曾和你一样，小家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3H_00000A6D_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A6D_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once like me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也曾和我一样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A6F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A6F_1.fuz NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A6F_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A6F_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: After my parents died... the Argonians took my village and drove me to the cities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父母死后……亚龙人占领了我的村子，把我赶到了城里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Sad
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A71_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A71_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did all sorts of things to survive, even begged... like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做过各种各样的事来活下去——甚至讨过饭……就像你一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Sad
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A73_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A73_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you are now a strong lady.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可你现在是一位坚强的女士了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A75_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A75_1.fuz NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A75_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A75_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I never gave up the fight, little one. And neither should you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我从未放弃过——小家伙。你也不该放弃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A77_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A77_1.fuz NPC : [03003F5F] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A6A (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaLucia1__00000A77_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3I_00000A77_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: My lady... would you like a flower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这位女士……您想要一朵花吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassaSofie1__00000A7C_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need a flower. But... fine. I'll have one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要花。不过……好吧。我拿一朵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaSofie1__00000A7E_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like someone I knew. Have I seen your mother before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来像我认识的一个人。我以前见过你母亲吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3L_00000A81_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaSofie1__00000A81_1.fuz NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaSofie1__00000A81_1.fuz Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaA_aaJenassaAmor3L_00000A81_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mama, she... she died long ago. I don't know much about her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我妈妈，她……她很久以前就去世了。我不太了解她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassaSofie1__00000A83_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I remember her. She was an alchemist, often went gathering ingredients near Kynesgrove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我记得她。她是个炼金术士，经常去凯恩之林附近采集材料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleDarkElf\aaJenassaSofie1__00000A85_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did she pick flowers like me? Can you... tell me more about her? Please?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她也像我一样采花吗？你能……多告诉我一些关于她的事吗？求你了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy
Audio : \Sound\Voice\FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp\FemaleChild\aaJenassaSofie1__00000A87_1.fuz

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe one day, little one. For now, we have a journey to pursue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许有一天吧，小家伙。但现在，我们还有路要赶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : [0300403B] (ID) NPC : Jenassa [000B9982] (file) Quest : 06000A79 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Child Banter Control
